idea: Safety #2 – crossing the street (SUNNY PARK, at the curb by a quiet crosswalk): Baby Jimmy's red ball bounces out of his hands and rolls across the empty crosswalk toward the camera ('Oh no! My ball! Stop, stop, stop!') – he reaches but stays behind the curb; chorus 'Stop! Look! Hold hands!'; step 1 STOP – 'Stop at the edge! Hands up, stop!' (copy-me: palms up); step 2 LOOK – 'Look this way! Look that way!' (copy-me: hand over the eyes, look both ways); step 3 HOLD HANDS – Daddy Tom kneels beside him and Jimmy puts his hand in Daddy's ('Hold Daddy's hand! Hold hands!'); he asks the viewer 'What do we do? Hmm?' (pause) – 'Stop! Look! Hold hands! Yay!'; lesson 'Hold hands to cross the street!'. Loop: the hook framing again, the street empty, the red ball safe in his arm, bye-bye wave.
title: Oh No! My Ball! 🚸 Stop, Look, Hold Hands with Baby Jimmy | Safety for Kids | Crayon Babies
description:
Oh no! Baby Jimmy's red ball rolls into the street! 🔴 Does he run after it? No – he stops! Sing along with Baby Jimmy and Daddy Tom and learn the three steps to cross the street safely: stop, look and hold hands.

🎬 What happens in this video:
😮 "Oh no! My ball!" – the ball bounces away, but Jimmy stays on the sidewalk
✋ Stop at the edge! Hands up, stop!
👀 Look this way! Look that way!
🤝 Hold Daddy's hand! Hold hands!
🤔 "What do we do?" – can you answer?
👋 Stop! Look! Hold hands! Bye bye, friends!

📚 Kids learn: road safety for toddlers • stop • look • hold hands • cross the street with a grown-up

🎶 Voices only: children singing, humming and clapping with a soft hand drum – no other musical instruments.

A fun sing-along safety song for toddlers and preschoolers, with Baby Jimmy and Daddy Tom at the edge of Sunny Park showing how to cross the street: stop at the edge, look both ways and always hold a grown-up's hand.
